objective: Reach an interactive, reproducible, result-ready ITES/SLED/SLED-V and AgentDojo implementation.
global_definition_of_done: Security semantics are covered by tests before implementation changes are accepted.
Every run records source, environment, policy and model versions.
Every external integration uses a pinned upstream revision and real fixture.
Blocked invalid proposals are diagnostics, not executed security violations.
Archived results are not presented as validation of the current implementation.
